required_outcomes: Tells Eliza Bennett (Alder Compliance) to stop the works now, citing the landlord's instruction.
Asks Eliza what has been done and what materials have been bought or committed, so the landlord can be charged only for that, and arranges the keys' return to the office.
Records the landlord's cancellation quoting his words, and confirms to him (after Eliza has been told) that the works are stopped and that work done and materials so far may be invoiced.
Holds the job for Eliza's reply with a review date, then closes or settles it on that basis; does not escalate.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord whether any item, such as the dripping bath tap or the broken plug, should still be finished before the sale.
Telling Kendall that the works will not go ahead.
positive_behaviours: Mentions the landlord's slow payment on the previous job when asking for a prompt settlement of any part-work invoice.
Makes sure the flat is left safe and secure if work stops half-way (water, electrics, flooring).
red_flags: Telling the landlord the works are stopped before Eliza has been told.
Escalating a clear change of instruction from the landlord.
prohibited_actions: Letting the works continue after the landlord's instruction to stop.
Closing the job as completed with payment of £1,370.
critical_failures: Ignoring the landlord's cancellation and letting Eliza carry on, or settling the full £1,370 for works that were stopped.
